children: Biocodex plans to invest €15M over the coming years in specialized live biotherapeutic manufacturing infrastructure for MRM Health programs. Pilot activities are expected to begin by 2027, with commercial-scale manufacturing targeted from 2030.
Creates a dedicated manufacturing pathway for MRM Health programs; Biocodex will fund, build, own and operate the facility.
Pilot manufacturing expected to begin by 2027
Near-term process development and pilot work would be an initial milestone toward the planned supply pathway.
Commercial supply remains a long-dated target, dependent on program and clinical progress.
Facility to support MH002 and other CORAL programs
The infrastructure could serve multiple pipeline and partnered programs, rather than MH002 alone.
MRM Health retains flexibility to use additional or alternative manufacturing partners.

This is an operational and partnership milestone for a clinical-stage biotech, building on Biocodex’s prior investment in MRM Health rather than reporting new clinical results. Progress toward the catalyst requires facility development, pilot manufacturing expected by 2027, and advancement of programs toward commercial-scale supply targeted from 2030.
Based on the original press release from MRM Health distributed by EQS.
